title: Egyptian–Ottoman War (1839–1841)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Egyptian–Ottoman War (1839–1841)", at revision 1379458367, opens: "The Second Egyptian–Ottoman War lasted from 1839 until 1841 and was fought mainly in Syria. It has sometimes been referred to as the Syrian War or Second Syrian War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2600326, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1839–1841 war between the Egyptian State and the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
